ضمان عام من الوكيل



Redragon Zeus FB H510 Gaming Headset – Specifications


General


Type: Wired Gaming Headset


Sound: Virtual 7.1 Surround Sound


Compatibility: PC, Laptop, PS4 / PS5, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, Mobile (3.5mm)


Connectivity: USB + 3.5 mm jack


Cable: Braided detachable cable (~2.2 m) (MEST Stores)


Audio (Headphones)

Driver Size: 53 mm

Frequency Response: 20 Hz – 20 kHz

Sensitivity: 110 ± 3 dB

Impedance: 64 Ω ± 15%

Rated Power: 20–30 mW (MEST Stores)


Microphone

Type: Detachable noise-cancelling boom mic

Direction: Omnidirectional

Mic Size: 6.0 × 2.7 mm

Sensitivity: −42 ± 3 dB

Frequency Response: 100 Hz – 10 kHz

Impedance: 2.2 KΩ (max)

Signal-to-Noise Ratio: 60 dB (MEST Stores)


Design & Features

Adjustable steel headband

Memory foam + leatherette ear cushions

Inline control (volume + mic mute)

USB sound card for virtual 7.1 audio

Lightweight design for long gaming sessions (Redragonshop)


In the Box


Headset

Detachable microphone

USB control box

3.5 mm splitter / adapter

Storage bag
